input.value: Rear-ended by another vehicle at approximately 35 mph; other driver did not brake
Car totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
Claimant injured: whiplash and sprained wrist

input.rationale: This is clearly an auto collision claim involving motor vehicle damage and personal injury sustained in a rear-end accident on Route 9.

Vehicle is totaled with severe structural damage (trunk crushed into back seat), claimant sustained multiple injuries (whiplash and sprained wrist), and damage magnitude appears to exceed the $750 deductible significantly.

input.claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended on Route 9 at approximately 8:15am yesterday at a red light. The other vehicle struck at ~35 mph without braking, causing total vehicle loss with trunk crushed into back seat. Claimant sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Other driver's insurance information is documented on the police report. Policy is active auto full coverage with $750 deductible and $100,000 limit. Claim classified as high-severity auto collision.
